svg.title: MediaLog — Extra ball
svg.desc: A game controller drawn in round orange plasma dots on a pinball backbox display, lit at three brightness levels with dark gaps between the dots. Primary brand colour #18223a, plain MediaLog wordmark. The dot-matrix grid with visible unlit dots and stepped brightness carries the backbox look into a square-ish panel; A controller, not text or a score, makes it the games mark of the set.
